- Ask AI in the menu of a message: Gemini, Claude, ChatGPT, DeepSeek or Grok on an MZGram screen of its own, with a sign-in profile apart from Telegram's. You sign in with your own account; MZGram puts the prompt and the message into the site's field and nothing is sent until you press Send on the site.
- Ask AI takes several selected messages and the photos and files of the messages: up to 10 in all, each up to 30 MB. The box lists them and says what was left out and why.
- Settings > MZGram > AI: a button in the chat list menu for each AI site, which opens it without a message. Off by default.
- Archive: Keep messages from (users, bots, groups, channels, all on by default), the archive's size at the top of the Archive topic, and Download in advance: a message is kept as it comes and its file is downloaded at once up to a limit for each kind of chat (users 300 MB, bots 5 MB, groups 20 MB, channels 5 MB, or No limit), and up to 100 MB more when it is deleted. Counters of saved, not downloaded and expired files, with Reset counters.
- Deleting the whole archive shows progress, then says how much was freed.
- Settings > MZGram > Interface > Show ID: the ID of a user, bot, group or channel in its profile, also your own in the header of Settings; a tap copies it. Hidden by default.
- A name taller than a line, as a name with runes, no longer goes over the number in the header of Settings.
- Settings > MZGram > Interface: switches that hide Telegram Premium, Telegram Stars, Gram Earnings, Telegram Business, Send a Gift, Wallet, Ask a Question, Telegram FAQ, Telegram Features and Privacy Policy in Telegram's Settings and its search.
- Notifications and Sounds > Reliable delivery: a permanent quiet notification keeps MZGram and its connection running, so messages and calls come on time on phones that stop apps in the background. Off by default.
- Notifications and Sounds > UnifiedPush > Device check: whether notifications are allowed, calls pop up, the battery limits the app, Reliable delivery is on and, on MIUI, autostart and the background and lock screen permissions. Each row opens the system screen; MZGram changes nothing itself.
- MZGram language: Same as Telegram is the new default, so MZGram's texts follow Telegram's language. A language chosen before is kept.
